recognize_zh: 胸部增強電腦斷層（CT）軸切面上，黃色箭頭圈出前／右側縱膈腔一個邊界清楚、分葉狀的大腫塊，顯影明顯且不均勻，推擠但未侵犯大血管；富血管的孤立縱膈淋巴結腫塊是 unicentric Castleman 病的典型影像表現。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced CT of the thorax at the level of the great vessels
Large, well-defined, lobulated anterior/right mediastinal mass (yellow arrows)
Intense, mildly heterogeneous enhancement approaching vascular density
Mass abuts and displaces adjacent vessels without obvious invasion or encasement
No pleural effusion or pulmonary nodule evident on this single slice
describe_en: Axial contrast-enhanced CT of the chest demonstrates a large, well-circumscribed, lobulated mass in the anterior and right mediastinum, outlined by yellow arrows. The mass shows intense, mildly heterogeneous contrast enhancement and abuts the adjacent great vessels without definite invasion. No pleural effusion is seen on this slice. A solitary, hypervascular, well-defined mediastinal mass is compatible with unicentric (hyaline-vascular) Castleman disease; tissue diagnosis is required to exclude lymphoma and other mediastinal neoplasms.

ddx.dx: Mediastinal lymphoma (e.g., primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma usually enhances only mildly, tends to encase vessels and may be necrotic, whereas hyaline-vascular Castleman disease is avidly enhancing; biopsy is decisive.
Thymoma is an anterior mediastinal soft-tissue mass with moderate enhancement rather than near-vascular enhancement, and histology shows thymic epithelium.
Paraganglioma is also hypervascular but usually arises in the paravertebral/aortopulmonary region and is confirmed by catecholamine studies and chromogranin/synaptophysin-positive zellballen.
Germ cell tumors often contain fat, calcification or cystic components and may have elevated AFP/beta-hCG, unlike the homogeneous hypervascular Castleman mass.
